Use case: ui-mockup. Create a production-quality desktop WEB MULTIPLAYER FISHING GAME gameplay screenshot, target dimensions 1536x1024. This is a NEW redesign called '호숫가 낚시터', not a village. References: first image original desired 3D casual art quality only; next two images current rejected implementation for character identity and gameplay, NOT palette or map layout. Preserve original chibi boy tousled brown hair teal jacket beige shorts and girl auburn bob coral jacket, extremely short 2-head proportions, cute large heads, never realistic. Fish are adorable round mascot characters, never realistic.
Art direction: rich jewel teal/turquoise lake, cool deep forest greens, natural weathered cedar piers, navy (#142c3a) game UI, teal (#277f85) buttons, white clear Korean labels, tiny warm brass accents. NO cream panels, no neon borders, no subtitles/slogans/explanatory text. Soft high-quality 3D mobile-game materials, depth, beautiful shadows, polished handmade environment, not bland repeating tiles.
Focused PLAYABLE CAMERA VIEW, overhead 3/4 orthographic 2.5D top-down game. Water covers majority, irregular natural shore, moss rocks, reeds, clear shallows and deep water, single little gear/bait kiosk by a lakeside trail rather than town architecture, two broad wooden fishing jetties linked to bank with completely connected traversable bridge. 5 tiny named players fishing sitting on chairs or walking on pier; silhouettes in water, bobbers, ripple reflections. Large world continues beyond screen, camera is close enough to see characters around 90px high, don't render whole map tiny. No village, no housing, no huge paving or cream cross roads. Land paths narrow slate/gravel.
Layout: top left small avatar with '김규택' and 5 gold stars; top right coins '1,240', bait '19', bag image icon. Single finished screen, no moodboard or multi-screen grid. Today's anchor 2026-11-25 if dates needed omitdates.
